notes.title: Minor update 1.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted jumping mechanics to make the player blocks more predictable and easier to control:
- Jumping no longer allows the player to speed up past the maximum speed
- Reduced movement authority while in the air. 
[*] Fixed bugs in the resolution selector.
- Fixed (hopefully) the bug that prevented changing the resolution 
- You can now select resolutions with aspect ratios other than 16:9
- Note that currently only 16:9 is officially supported and tested, other resolutions might experience UI glitches.
[/list]

notes.title: Blocked! Update 1.1 is live now!
notes.content:
Just in time for the prime couch multiplayer time of the year, update 1.1 and the first new minigame are here.

[list]
[*]Added the River Jump minigame
[*]Added the player position indicator as an optional toggle
[*]Improved stability when changing resolution
[*]Fixed some bugs
[/list]
